audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart said Skill on rows 0,2,3,4 where content/packet say Twisted Fate; tldr and a Do's title referenced a Ryze 'shield' that no longer exists in his kit; cooldowns field had no numbers; missing auto-reset tell on W.
audit.why: Content and packet agree: TF, Skill, TF, TF, TF, Ryze, Ryze. His W is 6s flat and an auto-attack reset, Q 6s rank 1, R 170/140/110. Ryze's current passive is bonus-mana damage — no shield.
audit.corrected: Full sides 0,2,3,4 moved to Twisted Fate (side-only, win[] already agrees) with why/rating rewrites; shield references replaced; cooldown numbers and the wind-up tell added.

edits.before: His burst wins the first ten seconds, your root and shield win the rest — make every exchange last eleven.
edits.after: His burst wins the first ten seconds, your root and range win the rest — make every exchange last eleven.

edits.before: Q-farm at max range — your level 1 is honest at best. Bank Tear stacks and give nothing away.
edits.after: His Wild Cards outrange your level 1 harass — Q-farm at max range and bank Tear stacks, give nothing away.

edits.before: E unlocks the real combo: E-Q flux chunks and the wave-bounce clears. The lane starts being yours to play.
edits.after: Gold Card is a point-and-click stun you cannot match yet — trade E-Q only when the yellow card is on cooldown.

edits.before: Tear + Lost Chapter and the EQ machine hums — short-trade his every wave contact and walk away before the answer.
edits.after: His maxed W stun and shove-and-roam tempo pressure you off the wave — short-trade EQ and hold the wave near tower.

edits.before: Realm Warp online — you are now a map play waiting to happen. The lane is a timer: shove and warp somewhere profitable.
edits.after: Destiny turns every Gold Card into a global roam — shove and ping when his R is up; don't try to out-rotate him yet.

edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Rune Prison for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - TF W Pick a Card: 6s flat — the locked gold card starts every trade and gank; back off the moment it glows yellow. - His Q runs 6s at rank 1. - His R Destiny falls to 110s late — ping on every shove. - Budget your W Rune Prison (11s) for emergencies.

edits.before: Cycle Q to keep the passive shield loaded
edits.after: Cycle Q to keep Overload runes charged

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: E-Q resets keep runes charged — the two-rune Overload speed burst is how you dodge his card wind-up and his Q lines.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: A gold card into Wild Cards at half HP chunks you for free and calls his jungler — the stack you greed pays his dice.

edits.before: His burst wins the first ten seconds, your root and shield win the rest — make every exchange last eleven.
edits.after: His burst wins the first ten seconds, your root and range win the rest — make every exchange last eleven.

edits.before: Track Twisted Fate’s Pick a Card (Gold): The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Twisted Fate’s Pick a Card: W is an auto-attack reset — the cue is the wind-up, not the cast; back off the moment the card glows yellow. Forward steps wait for its 6s downtime.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP is the map-game backbone. Nothing else is defensible on you.

edits.before: Q-farm at max range — your level 1 is honest at best. Bank Tear stacks and give nothing away.
edits.after: Wild Cards outranges your auto-and-Q harass — he pokes first; farm at max range and bank Tear.
